import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianAmbientRank
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianFlattening
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuasiProjectiveFiniteInAffine
import AlgebraicJacobian.Projective.Grassmannian

/-!
# A represented ambient Grassmannian for degree-d divisors

For every positive degree, a single tensor power of the chosen projective
line bundle supplies a quasi-projective representing Grassmannian scheme and
a natural monomorphism from the divisor functor into its functor of points. The
component formula identifies this map with the actual evaluation quotient,
and the candidate cokernel reconstructs the twisted divisor, with invertible
kernel, at the same exponent.

This is campaign D2, the divisor specialization of Nitsure, Section 5,
"Embedding Quot into Grassmannian", toward Kleiman's Section 3 `th:repDiv`
and Section 4 main theorem. The locally closed image required by D3, and
therefore representability of the positive-degree divisor functor itself,
remain separate obligations.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic

attribute [local instance] Scheme.moduleKSections

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The degree-`d` divisor functor embeds naturally into the functor of points
of a scheme representing its actual evaluation Grassmannian. The exponent,
ambient representation, evaluation surjectivity and quotient rank are all
produced from the curve hypotheses. -/
theorem exists_uniform_divisor_grassmannian_scheme
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (G : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
      (rep : (Scheme.Grassmannian ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) d).RepresentableBy G)
      (f : Scheme.DivFunctorDeg C.hom d ⟶ uliftYoneda.obj G),
      G.hom.IsHQuasiProjective ∧ Mono f ∧ ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
        (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T) (hx : x.HasFiberDeg d),
        ∃ (heval : Epi (x.grassmannianEval
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)))
          (hrank : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom T.hom)).obj
              (x.twist (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n))) d),
          rep.homEquiv (f.app (Opposite.op T) ⟨Quotient.mk _ x, hx⟩).down =
            x.grassmannianClass (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
              heval hrank ∧
          IsIso (Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianCandidateToTwist
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n) x heval hrank) ∧
          Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial
            (Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal
              (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)
              (x.grassmannianQuotient
                (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n) heval hrank)) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hdim, hn⟩ :=
    d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_and_kernel_counit_epi_with_rank_bound C d d
  let L := Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n
  have hL : Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L :=
    Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n
  have hV := Scheme.pushforward_isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_locallyTrivial_curve C L hL
  let G := Scheme.Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdim
  let rep := Scheme.Grassmannian.representation hV hd hdim
  have hG : G.hom.IsHQuasiProjective :=
    Scheme.Grassmannian.representingScheme_isHQuasiProjective_of_field hV hd hdim
  let heval : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T),
      x.HasFiberDeg d → Epi (x.grassmannianEval L) := fun T x hx => (hn T x hx).1
  let hrank : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (x : Scheme.DivFamily C.hom T),
      x.HasFiberDeg d → SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd C.hom T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d :=
    fun _ x hx => Scheme.DivFamily.pushforward_twist_isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_curve_arbitrary
      L hL x hx
  let g := Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianMap L hL d heval hrank
  haveI : Mono g :=
    Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianMap_mono_of_kernel_counit_epi L hL d heval hrank
      (fun _ => inferInstance) (fun T x hx => (hn T x hx).2)
  let e := Functor.RepresentableBy.equivUliftYonedaIso _ G rep
  refine ⟨n, G, rep, g ≫ e.inv, hG, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  intro T x hx
  refine ⟨heval T x hx, hrank T x hx, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change rep.homEquiv (rep.homEquiv.symm
      (g.app (Opposite.op T) ⟨Quotient.mk _ x, hx⟩)) = _
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianMap_app_mk L hL d heval hrank T x hx
  · haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
    haveI : L.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
    haveI : IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap
        (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom T.hom)).app L) :=
      canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso (IsPullback.of_hasPullback C.hom T.hom) L
    exact ⟨Scheme.DivFamily.grassmannianCandidateToTwist_isIso_of_kernel_counit_epi
      L x (heval T x hx) (hrank T x hx) (hn T x hx).2,
      Scheme.DivFamily.candidateIdeal_isLocallyTrivial_of_reconstruction
        L hL x (heval T x hx) (hrank T x hx) (hn T x hx).2⟩

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The D2 ambient producer also supplies the finite-affine substrate needed
for a later finite-Galois descent step.

The scheme here is only the Grassmannian ambient for the degree slice; this
does not assert that the divisor image is represented.  It records the
load-bearing consequence of the already-proved H-quasi-projective certificate:
every finite orbit in this ambient lies in one affine open. -/
theorem exists_uniform_divisor_grassmannian_scheme_with_finiteInAffine
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (G : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
      (rep : (Scheme.Grassmannian ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) d).RepresentableBy G)
      (f : Scheme.DivFunctorDeg C.hom d ⟶ uliftYoneda.obj G),
      G.hom.IsHQuasiProjective ∧ Scheme.FiniteInAffine G.left ∧ Mono f := by
  obtain ⟨n, G, rep, f, hG, hf, _⟩ :=
    exists_uniform_divisor_grassmannian_scheme C d hd
  exact ⟨n, G, rep, f, hG, Scheme.finiteInAffine_of_isHQuasiProjective hG, hf⟩

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Every positive divisor degree admits a uniform Grassmannian twist whose
universal candidate has a finite-support flat-degree stratum.  The strict rank
gap is obtained by asking the uniform evaluation theorem for rank `d + 1`.
This is the curve-specialized flattening producer in the D3 route; Cartier
openness and coverage by actual divisor families remain subsequent steps. -/
theorem exists_curve_flatDegree_candidate_stratum
    {k : Type} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    ∃ (n r : ℕ)
      (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.hom).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n)) r)
      (hdr : d ≤ r),
      let G := Scheme.Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr
      let p := pullback.snd C.hom G.hom
      let F := cokernel (Scheme.Grassmannian.universalKernelEvaluation
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n) hV hd hdr)
      ∃ (Z : Scheme) (i : Z ⟶ G.left),
        IsImmersion i ∧
        Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (pullback.snd p i)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst p i)).obj F) ∧
        (∀ z : Z, p.fiberH0 F (i z) = d) ∧
        ∀ (T : Scheme) (g : T ⟶ G.left),
          (∃! l : T ⟶ Z, l ≫ i = g) ↔
            Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (pullback.snd p g)
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst p g)).obj F) ∧
            ∀ t : T, p.fiberH0 F (g t) = d := by
  obtain ⟨n, hbound, _⟩ :=
    d2ProjectiveTwist_exists_uniform_tensorPow_eval_epi_and_geometric_generation_with_rank_bound
      C d (d + 1)
  let L := Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (d2ProjectiveTwist C) n
  let hL : Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L :=
    Scheme.Modules.tensorPow_isLocallyTrivial
      (d2ProjectiveTwist_isLocallyTrivial C) n
  let r := Module.finrank k Γ(L, (⊤ : C.left.Opens))
  have hdr : d < r := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hbound
  let hV := Scheme.pushforward_isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_locallyTrivial_curve C L hL
  let G : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    Scheme.Grassmannian.representingScheme hV hd hdr.le
  obtain ⟨Z, i, hi, hflat, hrank, hfactor⟩ :=
    Scheme.Grassmannian.exists_universalCandidate_flatDegree_stratum_of_curve
      C L hL hV hd hdr
  exact ⟨n, r, hV, hdr.le, Z, i, hi, hflat, hrank, hfactor⟩

end AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic
